h5HavenAngel.description:
Angels, Archangels and Seraphs are the level 7 units of the Heroes V Haven (merged into Castle). All of them can fly. Archangels also have {Resurrect Allies} (resurrects 101 × the number of Archangels in Hit Points of an allied stack, 1 time per battle, 2 times from experience level 7). Seraphs can also cast {Righteous Might} and {Divine Vengeance} (2 times per battle, 14 mana).

In the world of Ashan, Angels are the human-shaped incarnations of Elrath, the Dragon of Light, and the ultimate embodiment of its power. These creatures of light fight bravely and strike with deadly force. Legend has it that even if an Angel's body is destroyed, its soul returns to the Dragon of Light to await the chance to serve its lord again.

See also {Archangel}, {Seraph}.

bonus.description:
{Steadfast Mind}
Immune to Mind spells

{Immune to Armageddon}
Unaffected by Armageddon

{Water Ward}
Immune to harmful Water spells

h5HavenArchangel.description:
Angels, Archangels and Seraphs are the level 7 units of the Heroes V Haven (merged into Castle). All of them can fly. Archangels also have {Resurrect Allies} (resurrects 101 × the number of Archangels in Hit Points of an allied stack, 1 time per battle, 2 times from experience level 7). Seraphs can also cast {Righteous Might} and {Divine Vengeance} (2 times per battle, 14 mana).

Archangels are the highest creatures in the sacred hierarchy of the Dragon of Light's servants. Their souls come from the bravest, most fearless and most loyal heroes of ancient times. As lieutenants of the Dragon of Light, they hold the supreme power to resurrect warriors in battle, so that those warriors can serve their master once more.

See also {Angel}, {Seraph}.

bonus.description:
{Steadfast Mind}
Immune to Mind spells

{Water Ward}
Immune to harmful Water spells

h5HavenArcher.description:
Archers, Bolt Archers and Crossbowmen are the level 2 units of the Heroes V Haven (merged into Castle). All of them can shoot. Archers have {Scatter Shot} (fires at an area, where friend and foe alike take half ranged damage). Bolt Archers also have {Precise Shot} (ignores the target's Defense when shooting at a distance of less than 3 hexes). Crossbowmen also have {No Range Penalty} (no penalty for distance when shooting).

Archers are very useful in battle, as they can weaken the enemy before the lines meet. The Archers of the Griffin Empire excel at loosing dense volleys of arrows to destroy their foes.

See also {Bolt Archer}, {Crossbowman}.

bonus.description:
{Siege Shooter}
No damage loss when shooting over walls

h5HavenCavalier.description:
Knights, Paladins and Champions are the level 6 units of the Heroes V Haven (merged into Castle). All of them have {Jousting} (+5% damage for every hex moved in the charge). Paladins also have {Immune to Berserk} (immune to the Berserk curse) and {Lay Hands} (fully heals one creature of an allied stack and removes all negative spells from it). Champions also have {Champion Charge} (when attacking after a charge of 2 or more hexes, the unit behind the target takes 50% damage).

Knights are the shock troops of the Holy Griffin Empire. Clad in heavy armor and mounted on powerful warhorses, they charge the enemy from afar, which is their most powerful form of attack.

See also {Paladin}, {Champion}.

bonus.description:
{Steady Ranks}
Immune to charge damage bonuses

{No Retaliation}
Enemy cannot retaliate when attacked

h5HavenCleric.description:
Priests, Inquisitors and Zealots are the level 5 units of the Heroes V Haven (merged into Castle). All of them can shoot and have {No Melee Penalty}. Inquisitors can also cast {Haste}, {Divine Strength} and {Endurance} (3 times per battle, 12 mana). Zealots can also cast {Cleansing} and {Righteous Might} (2 times per battle, 15 mana), and have {Purge} (attacks have a chance to dispel the target's beneficial spells).

Inquisitors are the faithful defenders of the teachings of Elrath, the Dragon of Light. They never hesitate to rush into battle against heretics or any enemy that threatens the Church. Inquisitors take no part in hand-to-hand fighting; they usually strike their enemies by calling down the wrath of Elrath. They can also cast protective and strengthening spells on their allies.

See also {Priest}, {Zealot}.

bonus.description:
{Steadfast Mind}
Immune to Mind spells

h5HavenFootman.description:
Footmen, Squires and Vindicators are the level 3 units of the Heroes V Haven (merged into Castle). All of them have {Enrage} (Attack increases when an allied stack is destroyed) and {Large Shield} (half damage from ranged attacks). Footmen have {Shield Bash} (melee attacks have a chance to stun the target, which cannot retaliate and has its ATB reset to 0). Squires also have {Shield Allies} (adjacent allies take half damage from ranged attacks) and {Shield Bash} (melee attacks have a chance to stun the target, which cannot retaliate and has its ATB reset to 0). Vindicators also have {Cleave} (attacks once more when an attack kills at least 1 creature).

Footmen are the core defensive force of the Griffin Empire's army. They can effectively hold back enemy assaults, giving the Empire's other troops the chance to destroy the enemy.

See also {Squire}, {Vindicator}.

h5HavenGriffin.description:
Griffins, Imperial Griffins and Battle Griffins are the level 4 units of the Heroes V Haven (merged into Castle). All of them can fly and have {Unlimited Retaliation} and {Immune to Blind} (immune to the Blind curse). Imperial Griffins also have {Battle Dive} (soars into the air for one round, then dives for 2 times damage, hitting friend and foe alike). Battle Griffins also have {Battle Frenzy} (each retaliation deals 1.5 times the damage of the previous one) and {Pack Dive} (dives and sweeps across two rows of enemies for 75% damage, 1 time per battle).

Griffins are the fastest troops of the Haven faction, and the whole Empire takes its name from them. They excel at striking in skirmishes, flying into the enemy ranks from afar. When forced into melee, Griffins are relatively weak, but whatever happens they always fight to the last drop of blood.

See also {Imperial Griffin}, {Battle Griffin}.

h5HavenMarksman.description:

Archers have {Scatter Shot} (fires at an area, where friend and foe alike take half ranged damage). Bolt Archers also have {Precise Shot} (ignores the target's Defense when shooting at a distance of less than 3 hexes). Crossbowmen also have {No Range Penalty} (no penalty for distance when shooting).

Bolt Archers are a key force in battle, as they can weaken the enemy before the lines meet. Their powerful crossbows are loaded with devastating lightning bolts, which are especially deadly at close range.

See also {Archer}, {Crossbowman}.

h5HavenMilitiaman.description:
Peasants, Conscripts and Thugs are the level 1 units of the Heroes V Haven (merged into Castle). All of them have {Taxpayer} (each one brings the hero 1 gold per day). Conscripts also have {Shield Bash} (melee attacks have a chance to stun the target, which cannot retaliate and has its ATB reset to 0). Thugs also have {Brutality} (melee attacks have a chance to strike twice).

Conscripts are the basic infantry of the Holy Griffin Empire. Though quite weak and poorly trained, they are very numerous and in melee can often leave their enemies dazed.

See also {Peasant}, {Thug}.

h5HavenPaladin.description:
Knights, Paladins and Champions are the level 6 units of the Heroes V Haven (merged into Castle). All of them have {Jousting} (+5% damage for every hex moved in the charge). Paladins also have {Immune to Berserk} (immune to the Berserk curse) and {Lay Hands} (fully heals one creature of an allied stack and removes all negative spells from it). Champions also have {Champion Charge} (when attacking after a charge of 2 or more hexes, the unit behind the target takes 50% damage).

Paladins are the elite troops and ultimate guardians of the Holy Griffin Empire. Clad in heavy armor and mounted on powerful warhorses, they charge the enemy from afar, which is their most powerful form of attack. They can also dispel harmful spells that the enemy has cast on their army.

See also {Knight}, {Champion}.

h5HavenPeasant.description:
Peasants, Conscripts and Thugs are the level 1 units of the Heroes V Haven (merged into Castle). All of them have {Taxpayer} (each one brings the hero 1 gold per day). Conscripts also have {Shield Bash} (melee attacks have a chance to stun the target, which cannot retaliate and has its ATB reset to 0). Thugs also have {Brutality} (melee attacks have a chance to strike twice).

Peasants are the most basic infantry of the Holy Griffin Empire. They are weak and lack proper training, but they win by sheer numbers. Peasants are an important source of the nation's income.

See also {Conscript}, {Thug}.

Priests are the faithful defenders of the Griffin Empire's faith. They rush into battle against heretics or any enemy that threatens the Church of Elrath. As men of the cloth they take no part in hand-to-hand fighting, and usually strike their enemies by calling down the wrath of their god.

See also {Inquisitor}, {Zealot}.

From the moment they are born, Battle Griffins know how to endure pain and repay the enemy with even fiercer vengeance. Nothing dares approach an adult griffin. Once a Battle Griffin is wounded or attacked, it strikes back even more fiercely.

Thugs regard brutality as a necessary means of achieving their goals. These iron-hard warriors never fear war; their arms move like the wind as they wipe out every obstacle in their path.
